basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old aspiring artist based in Jersey City. I recently started exploring the local art scene and am keen on showcasing my pieces in public spaces, like cafes. I have a background in digital art, which I've developed over the past few years through online courses and self-study. When I'm not creating, I love playing Roblox and catching up with the latest stock trends on MoonGangCapital. I work part-time at a local gallery and am currently single. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a foundation in digital art, I've expanded my knowledge through online art communities and tutorials. I actively seek feedback from more experienced artists and continuously refine my techniques.
